issues.title: Delayed Push Notifications on Android 14
issues.description: Background notification delivery delayed by up to 5 minutes on Android devices when power-saving mode is active.
issues.root_cause_description: Android 14 standby bucket restrictions suspend WebSocket listener when client is backgrounded.
issues.recommended_action: Migrate background push wakeups to High Priority FCM payload with local alarm manager.
issues.expected_impact: Restores immediate incoming call alerts for 4.2M Android users

issues.title: High-DPI Multi-Monitor Window Blur
issues.description: Client UI rasterization degrades into blurry text when dragged between 4K UHD monitors and 1080p laptop displays.
issues.root_cause_description: Per-monitor DPI v2 awareness message dropped during desktop compositor cross-monitor handoff.
issues.recommended_action: Enable dynamic WM_DPICHANGED handler in native Electron shell wrapper.
issues.expected_impact: Resolves display friction on dual-monitor executive workstations

issues.title: External Attendee Calendar Sync Latency
issues.description: Meeting invites created by external Microsoft 365 tenants take up to 10 minutes to populate channel calendar tab.
issues.root_cause_description: Webhook backpressure queue on Exchange Graph delta synchronization during morning peak hours.
issues.recommended_action: Introduce partitioned Kafka consumer groups for cross-tenant calendar webhooks.
issues.expected_impact: Reduces external meeting sync latency from 10 minutes to under 8 seconds

issues.title: Payment Gateway Timeout on Subscription Renewal
issues.description: Enterprise workspace renewal transactions failing with gateway 504 timeouts, preventing user license allocations.
issues.root_cause_description: Microservice timeout in billing proxy when validating corporate tax exemptions.
issues.recommended_action: Deploy retry queue on commerce proxy and increase timeout ceiling to 10s.

issues.title: Endless MFA Loop & Expired OTP Tokens
issues.description: Users repeatedly prompted for multi-factor authentication due to expired token caching on Safari and mobile web.
issues.root_cause_description: Cross-domain session cookie partitioning in modern browsers invalidates auth token.
issues.recommended_action: Migrate authentication handshake to Storage Access API and extend OTP TTL.
issues.expected_impact: Eliminates 90% of repeated sign-in support tickets

issues.title: Bluetooth Headset Disconnects During Screen Sharing
issues.description: Audio driver renegotiation crashes Bluetooth A2DP profile when desktop compositor begins screen capture.
issues.root_cause_description: Exclusive mode lock on WASAPI audio device during capture initialization.
issues.recommended_action: Switch audio subsystem capture hook to shared audio endpoint mode.
issues.expected_impact: Resolves call interruptions for 180K daily headset users
